PlayerKarteaConfigService

class PlayerKarteaConfigService(dao=None, calibration_service=None, player_service=None, professional_service=None, hardware_service=None)[source]

Bases: object

Service layer (MVCS) with the business rules of the config.

Hardware (screen, camera, calibration, MediaPipe) lives in KarteaHardwareService, available as hardware_service. Phases, levels, progression and level rules live in KarteaPhaseService.

Parameters:
daoPlayerKarteaConfigCsvDAO | None, optional

Instance used for persistence. If None, a default PlayerKarteaConfigCsvDAO is created. Kept private: callers go through the service methods.

calibration_serviceCalibrationService | None, optional

Used to build the hardware service when hardware_service is not given.

player_servicePlayerService | None, optional

Player service. Created if None.

professional_serviceProfessionalService | None, optional

Professional service. Created if None.

hardware_serviceKarteaHardwareService | None, optional

Screen, camera, calibration and MediaPipe. Created if None.

Attributes:
INTERFACE_OPTIONStuple[str, …], class attribute

Interface options (bool) that can be toggled during the game: “hud”, “sound”, “feet_marker” and “feet_click”.

hardware_serviceKarteaHardwareService

Screen, camera, calibration and MediaPipe.

player_servicePlayerService

Access to the T-TEA players.

professional_serviceProfessionalService

Access to the T-TEA professionals.

session_servicePlayerKarteaSessionService

Session service that shares the configuration DAO’s session DAO.

session_detail_servicePlayerKarteaSessionDetailService

Session detail service that shares the session DAO.

property session_detail_service: PlayerKarteaSessionDetailService

Session detail service that shares the session DAO.

Notes

Created on first use (only the game records details; the register screens do not need to read the details CSV). A single instance per configuration service, so the detail ID counter is not duplicated between instances.

Complete list of PlayerKarteaConfig instances stored in the DAO.

create_config(data)[source]

Create a new config from a dictionary of attributes.

Parameters:
datadict[str, Any]

Same format as get_default_config_data: player_id, session_id, phase_id, level_id and the plain fields of PlayerKarteaConfig.

Returns:
PlayerKarteaConfig | None

The created config if validation and insertion succeed; None otherwise.

Notes

  • The ids are resolved to objects through the DAOs; missing ids become None.

  • A missing plain field gets the model default or, without one, the empty value of its type (0, 0.0, False, “”). update_session_id defaults to UPDATE_SESSION_ID_YES.

  • The config must have player, phase and level (is_valid).

update_config(player_id, data)[source]

Update an existing config.

Parameters:
player_idint

Player ID (key of the config).

datadict[str, Any]

Same format as create_config; only the given keys change.

Returns:
bool

True if saved; False if the config does not exist, becomes invalid (no player, phase or level) or the DAO rejects it.

Notes

Fields missing from data keep their current value; the references are resolved again from the current ids.

update_config_session(player_id, session_id)[source]

Record the current game session in the player’s config.

Parameters:
player_idint

Player ID.

session_idint

Id of the current session.

Returns:
bool

True if the config was updated.

Notes

Only records it if the config has update_session_id = True; otherwise, the session recorded in the config is kept.

update_config_level(player_id, phase_id, level_id)[source]

Record in the config the phase/level the game is on.

Parameters:
player_idint

Player ID.

phase_idint

Current phase.

level_idint

Current level.

Returns:
bool

True if the config holds the given phase/level.

Notes

The config follows the game (advance, regress, etc.), and the next session starts where the previous one stopped. The file is only rewritten when the phase or the level changes.
